decisions.why: categories are explicitly Fetal Monitoring/Fetal Dopplers, and examples (Dawes Redman Analysis, fetal probes, Sonicaid Centrale) are CTG/foetal monitoring products
LymphAssist and Hydroven IPC garments/systems are intermittent pneumatic compression devices, i.e. compression therapy
Smartsigns Compact 300/500 are basic ward spot-check vital signs monitors, matching non-specialist monitoring
